description.name: Entry
description.text:
7 single ranged jump attacks (0.90 each) capped at 19999, grants [Attach Wind with Stacking]/[Attach Lightning with Stacking]/[Attach Water with Stacking]/[Attach Dark with Stacking] depending on entry damage, grants [Damage Cap +10000], [Crystal Force Mode], and [Crystal Force Mode: Ricard] to the user
Crystal Force Mode: Ricard: Dragoon Ability Boost, Dualcast Dragoon, Zero Hone Cost to Dragoon Abilities & 25% DEF/RES Pierce

description.name: Crystal Force I
description.text: 4 single ranged jump attacks (2.00 each) capped at 19999, grants [Damage +50% Boost 1] and [Damage Cap +10000 1] to all Dragoon allies, grants [Instant Cast 1], [DEF and RES 50% Piercing 1], and [200% ATB 1] to the user

description.name: Crystal Force II
description.text: 4 single ranged jump attacks (2.00 each) capped at 19999, grants [Damage +50% Boost 1] and [Damage Cap +10000 1] to all Dragoon allies, grants [Instant Cast 1], [DEF and RES 50% Piercing 1], and [200% ATB 1] to the user

description.name: Attach Wind with Stacking
description.text: Increase Attach Wind Level by 1 and increase Max Attach Element Level by 2, up to Attach Wind 3

description.name: Attach Lightning with Stacking
description.text: Increase Attach Lightning Level by 1 and increase Max Attach Element Level by 2, up to Attach Lightning 3

description.name: Attach Water with Stacking
description.text: Increase Attach Water Level by 1 and increase Max Attach Element Level by 2, up to Attach Water 3

description.name: Attach Dark with Stacking
description.text: Increase Attach Dark Level by 1 and increase Max Attach Element Level by 2, up to Attach Dark 3

description.name: Crystal Force Mode
description.text: Grants Crystal Force Mode, Replaces Attack and Defend commands with Crystal Force I & II, unlocks II after three actions
